title: Battle of Bergendal
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Bergendal", at revision 1370107735, opens: "The Battle of Berg-en-dal took place in South Africa during the Second Anglo-Boer War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1767196, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1900 battle of the Second Boer War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
